headline: 4 arrested after man beaten to death in Chattogram’s Bakalia
summary: A 21-year-old man was killed after being accused of attempting to steal from a betel leaf and cigarette stall.
details: A 21-year-old man, identified as Md Emon, was beaten to death in the Bakalia area of Chattogram after being accused of attempting to steal from a betel leaf and cigarette stall.
Police recovered his body this afternoon from under a bridge in the Bakalia-Kalpalok residential area.
Following a case filed by the victim's family, police have arrested four suspects: Abdur Rahman Zisan (21), Yasin Arafat (23), Md Hasan (33), and Md Mizanur Rahman (27).
Bakalia Police Station Officer-in-Charge Md Shahinur Alam stated that Emon was assaulted by a group of people after the theft accusation.
The OC added that the victim was beaten severely and died on the spot.
A video circulating on social media shows the victim with his hands tied, being escorted by several men carrying sticks, and subsequently being beaten.
caption:
A 21-year-old man was beaten to death in Chattogram after being accused of theft.

A 21-year-old man, identified as Md Emon, was beaten to death in the Bakalia area of Chattogram after being accused of attempting to steal from a betel leaf and cigarette stall.

Police recovered his body this afternoon from under a bridge in the Bakalia-Kalpalok residential area.

Following a case filed by the victim's family, police have arrested four suspects: Abdur Rahman Zisan (21), Yasin Arafat (23), Md Hasan (33), and Md Mizanur Rahman (27).

Bakalia Police Station Officer-in-Charge Md Shahinur Alam stated that Emon was assaulted by a group of people after the theft accusation.

The OC added that the victim was beaten severely and died on the spot.

A video circulating on social media shows the victim with his hands tied, being escorted by several men carrying sticks, and subsequently being beaten.

Source: The Daily Star

headline: 15,000+ passengers stranded as 103 Dhaka-Saudi flights cancelled
summary: Flight restrictions in Saudi Arabia have led to massive cancellations, leaving thousands of travelers in distress.
details: Over 15,000 passengers have been affected by the cancellation of 103 flights between Dhaka and Saudi Arabia.
The disruptions were caused by flight restrictions imposed in Saudi Arabia, leading to widespread chaos for travelers.
Many passengers are now stranded, facing significant uncertainty regarding their travel plans and rescheduling.
The sudden restrictions have caused immense suffering and distress for thousands of migrant workers and travelers.
caption:
103 flights cancelled, 15,000+ passengers stranded. Travel between Dhaka and Saudi Arabia is in chaos.

Over 15,000 passengers have been affected by the cancellation of 103 flights between Dhaka and Saudi Arabia.

Many passengers are now stranded, facing significant uncertainty regarding their travel plans and rescheduling.

The sudden restrictions have caused immense suffering and distress for thousands of migrant workers and travelers.
